description: Search all altziar.ro stories by words in the title and summary or by people and institutions involved (diacritics optional). Write the query in Romanian when possible, e.g. "guvern buget" or "Nicușor Dan". If few stories match the words, stories close in meaning are added separately. Returns title, url, short summary and dates for each story.

limit.description: How many stories to return (1-20, default 10).

query.description: Words, a name or a short question, preferably in Romanian.

name: search_stories
title: Search Romanian news
